name: khoa-cntt
description: Quản lý công việc Khoa CNTT — React + NestJS + SQL Server

scripts.build: npm run build -w @khoa/shared && npm run build -w @khoa/api && npm run build -w @khoa/web && npm run build -w @khoa/mobile
scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w @khoa/shared && npm run dev -w @khoa/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @khoa/shared && npm run typecheck -w @khoa/api && npm run typecheck -w @khoa/web && npm run typecheck -w @khoa/mobile
